The worst attitude from the server
Jul 2019 • Business
We went there for lunch meeting. It was the rainy day. When we arrived, the restaurant was somewhat empty, and the server was nice to us. We informed the server that we are waiting for a few more people for our meeting and she said they will reserve the next table for us when the others arrive. While we are looking at the menu, there is a group of Koreans arrived and occupied the section next to us. The server then proceeded to ask my friends what she likes to order, my friend told the server that she might just get a drink at that time. Without asking other people in the group for the order, the server told our group that this is the lunch time, and if we just order drinks, we need to move to the outside section, next to the smoking area. We voiced our concern about her attitude toward us, and asked to speak to the manager or owner. The server said she is the one in charge and there is no body else. She continues to demand us to move to outside section despite our objection. We asked her to leave our table, but she refused and continue to demand us to go to outside section while it was raining. 

We got upset with her treatment and again asked for management staff and was told that there is no manager on duty. The incident kept escalating with the server persistently demand that we need to move to outside section.

We ended up leaving the restaurant.

As customers, we don't deserve to be treated like second class citizen like this. This is the worst attitude that we ever experienced from any places. It appears that the restaurant and the server discriminated against Vietnamese customers. More training about diversity is needed for the server. She needs to understand no means no and stop insulting customers.

We will not return to this restaurant

Mouth-Watering Italian Food You'll Be Dreaming About For Months
May 2019 • Business
Is there anything better than a creamy lobster penne followed by an irresistible tiramisu? Didn't think so. 

I had an incredible dinner experience at Tavola last night. The food was truly authentic Italian. And when I say authentic, I mean the chef himself is renowned from Sardinia. Not only was he an extremely friendly presence, but his dishes were delectable! 

I was started with an Atlantic red tuna salad which was so flavourful I could have gone for round two (and that's saying a lot, considering I typically eat salad as a "I'm trying to eat healthy option" only). 

Onto the pasta, I had the mediterranean clam spaghetti (spaghetti alla bottarga e vongole) and the market lobster penne (penne all' astice), I mean can you really go wrong with either? I absolutely loved them both, choosing one may be the hardest decision of 2019. 

The sirloin was also cooked to perfection and tender as ever! It was such a treat, as I find it quite difficult to hunt down in Saigon.

Lastly (but certainly not least) the tiramisu. Where do I even begin? It's 100% an absolute must! I know for a fact I will be back even just for this. Wow wow wow, I have not stopped thinking about this dessert since I devoured it in a matter of seconds!

Not only is the food wonderful, the restaurant itself is fabulous. With a floor to ceiling bar, open kitchen, a gorgeous dining area and lovely staff, everything ties in beautifully to make this spot a great find in the middle of Saigon!

I will certainly, certainly be back! Yum!

Bad food, poor service and overcharged
Jan 2019 • Couples
I went to this restaurant with my girlfriend thinking it’d be a nice place to go. I could not be anymore wrong! The food here is terrible, the waitress got our orders wrong and then would not let us return both dishes. Instead we could only return one. They also brought us out still water, which is always complementary, but they charged us 80,000 DNG ($4USD) for it because it was “from Italy”....nobody told us there was a cost associated with the water. The food took a long time to come and the pasta was undercooked and the sauce was canned. Overall a very poor dish that set me back $6 USD. The pizza was next to come out, I was pleasantly surprised by the size of it. However, my happiness was short lived as the pizza also had canned sauce and the dough was not properly cooked. After waiting another 15 or so minutes, the lasagna finally came out. It was just pasta with no meat to it and once again, the canned sauce. Capping off a terrible dining experience, the prices do not include VAT and further infuriating myself, they have a compulsory 5% tip! We told them that we were not paying for water or the tip, to which they said “you have too, it’s imported from Italy”, after sitting there very disappointed with my experience and explaining this to the waiter, he took a measly 30,000DNG off the bill, this became 50,000DNG we when said there was no way we’d pay the tip! Please do not waste your money on this ‘fine dining experience’, you will regret it!

tavolaofficial
Dear Liam, 

We are sorry that you endured a such a bad experience. We would love to clear up a few points so that there is no confusion:

1. We are not fine-dining. We are a casual, authentic Italian restaurant. Many ingredients are sourced from Italy and therefore the prices. We are sorry that you thought we are fine-dining. We do not think of nor market ourselves this way. Our care is only about the quality of the food and the method of cooking. We serve “classic”” Italian dishes.

2. I’m sorry about the confusion with water – we do only serve Acqua Panna still or sparkling water, never tap. We take care to purchase only glass bottles to be able to recycle and therefore, again, why the cost of the water is higher than you’d expect. We do not boil tap water and serve it to our customers – we aim to truly be authentic in Italian taste, and therefore use Italian produce. 

3. We are so sorry that the food took a really long time to arrive. This is completely our fault. We will strive to do better next time. 

4. We never use canned sauce, our chef, PierFranco Mannazzu uses his own recipe made from fresh tomato. 

5. Our VAT & Service Charge is noted on our menu. This is also quite common for most restaurants to have. 
Hope that you can understand this from our side as well. We are truly very sorry you had a terrible experience. You must have the wrong expectation of our restaurant which again may be our own fault. We will work on projecting the correct image so that there is no confusion in the future. 

Thank you for your feedback, Liam, and Happy Tet. 

Best Regards, 
Tavola
